Introduction

Base URL: http://localhost:8081 
This documentation aims to provide all the information you need to work with our API.

<aside>As you scroll, you'll see code examples for working with the API in different programming languages in the dark area to the right (or as part of the content on mobile).
You can switch the language used with the tabs at the top right (or from the nav menu at the top left on mobile).</aside>

Authenticating requests

To authenticate requests, include an Authorization header with the value "Bearer {YOUR_SANCTUM_TOKEN}".

All authenticated endpoints are marked with a requires authentication badge in the documentation below.

Token Sanctum emitido con php artisan integrations:create-token "Nombre" --permission="manage X". El token solo puede llamar a los endpoints cubiertos por los permisos otorgados.

Customers

GET api/v1/customers

requires authentication

Example request:
curl --request GET \
    --get "http://localhost:8081/api/v1/customers" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_SANCTUM_TOKEN}" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json"
const url = new URL(
    "http://localhost:8081/api/v1/customers"
);

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_SANCTUM_TOKEN}",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};


fetch(url, {
    method: "GET",
    headers,
}).then(response => response.json());

Cancel an invoice

requires authentication

Creates a credit note that reverses the invoice's totals and stock movements, and marks the original invoice as cancelled. The invoice stays in the system; it is not deleted.

Example request:
curl --request POST \
    "http://localhost:8081/api/v1/invoices/16/cancel" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_SANCTUM_TOKEN}" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json"
const url = new URL(
    "http://localhost:8081/api/v1/invoices/16/cancel"
);

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_SANCTUM_TOKEN}",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};


fetch(url, {
    method: "POST",
    headers,
}).then(response => response.json());

    }
}

Create a partial (or full) credit note

requires authentication

Devolución parcial (o total, si se indican todas las cantidades disponibles) de una factura. A diferencia de cancel(), la factura original no queda cancelada.

Example request:
curl --request POST \
    "http://localhost:8081/api/v1/invoices/16/credit-notes" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_SANCTUM_TOKEN}" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json" \
    --data "{
    \"lines\": [
        {
            \"invoice_item_id\": 905,
            \"quantity\": 6
        }
    ]
}"

const url = new URL(
    "http://localhost:8081/api/v1/invoices/16/credit-notes"
);

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_SANCTUM_TOKEN}",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

let body = {
    "lines": [
        {
            "invoice_item_id": 905,
            "quantity": 6
        }
    ]
};

fetch(url, {
    method: "POST",
    headers,
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
}).then(response => response.json());

Orders

POST /api/v1/orders is handled by the (reused) App\Http\Controllers\OrderController::store() — see that method's docblock for its parameters.

List orders

requires authentication

Example request:
curl --request GET \
    --get "http://localhost:8081/api/v1/orders?customer_id=211&status=pending&per_page=25" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_SANCTUM_TOKEN}" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json"
const url = new URL(
    "http://localhost:8081/api/v1/orders"
);

const params = {
    "customer_id": "211",
    "status": "pending",
    "per_page": "25",
};
Object.keys(params)
    .forEach(key => url.searchParams.append(key, params[key]));

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_SANCTUM_TOKEN}",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};


fetch(url, {
    method: "GET",
    headers,
}).then(response => response.json());

Create an order

requires authentication

Creates a pending (or completed) order with its line items and immediately reduces stock for each product. If unit_price is omitted for a line, the price is resolved from the customer's price list (see PriceResolutionService).

Example request:
curl --request POST \
    "http://localhost:8081/api/v1/orders" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_SANCTUM_TOKEN}" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json" \
    --data "{
    \"customer_id\": 211,
    \"warehouse_id\": 1,
    \"status\": \"pending\",
    \"items\": [
        {
            \"product_id\": 16,
            \"quantity\": 24,
            \"unit_price\": 17.69
        }
    ]
}"

const url = new URL(
    "http://localhost:8081/api/v1/orders"
);

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_SANCTUM_TOKEN}",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

let body = {
    "customer_id": 211,
    "warehouse_id": 1,
    "status": "pending",
    "items": [
        {
            "product_id": 16,
            "quantity": 24,
            "unit_price": 17.69
        }
    ]
};

fetch(url, {
    method: "POST",
    headers,
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
}).then(response => response.json());

    "http://localhost:8081/api/v1/stock-movements/16"
);

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_SANCTUM_TOKEN}",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};


fetch(url, {
    method: "GET",
    headers,
}).then(response => response.json());

Example request:
curl --request GET \
    --get "http://localhost:8081/api/v1/suppliers" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_SANCTUM_TOKEN}" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json"
const url = new URL(
    "http://localhost:8081/api/v1/suppliers"
);

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_SANCTUM_TOKEN}",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};


fetch(url, {
    method: "GET",
    headers,
}).then(response => response.json());

Example: application/json

Accept        

Example: application/json

GET api/v1/suppliers/{supplier_id}

requires authentication

Example request:
curl --request GET \
    --get "http://localhost:8081/api/v1/suppliers/16" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_SANCTUM_TOKEN}" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json"
const url = new URL(
    "http://localhost:8081/api/v1/suppliers/16"
);

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_SANCTUM_TOKEN}",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};


fetch(url, {
    method: "GET",
    headers,
}).then(response => response.json());

You can check the Dev Tools console for debugging information.

Request      

GET api/v1/suppliers/{supplier_id}

Headers

Authorization        

Example: Bearer {YOUR_SANCTUM_TOKEN}

Content-Type        

Example: application/json

Accept        

Example: application/json

URL Parameters

supplier_id   integer     

The ID of the supplier. Example: 16

POST api/v1/suppliers

requires authentication

Example request:
curl --request POST \
    "http://localhost:8081/api/v1/suppliers" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_SANCTUM_TOKEN}" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json" \
    --data "{
    \"name\": \"b\",
    \"tax_id\": \"n\",
    \"email\": \"ashly64@example.com\",
    \"phone\": \"v\",
    \"address\": \"d\"
}"

const url = new URL(
    "http://localhost:8081/api/v1/suppliers"
);

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_SANCTUM_TOKEN}",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

let body = {
    "name": "b",
    "tax_id": "n",
    "email": "ashly64@example.com",
    "phone": "v",
    "address": "d"
};

fetch(url, {
    method: "POST",
    headers,
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
}).then(response => response.json());
